errors.text: The proposed NbMoTaWVCr composition is predominantly Group V-VI rather than the requested Group IV-V Hf-Nb-Ta-Ti-Zr family.
The central fabrication route is incorrect: powder-bed SLM plus HPT replaces hydride-based ink extrusion, hydrogen de-binding, vacuum sintering, and water quenching.
The proposed optimum nanocrystalline BCC/Laves/oxide composite is incompatible with the target metastable single beta-BCC state containing approximately 1 wt.% oxygen.
The impurity mechanism is reversed: the target exploits controlled oxygen for interstitial strengthening, whereas the hypothesis assumes oxygen must be minimized or absorbed at grain boundaries.
Claims of creep resistance, oxidation resistance, coherent precipitates, and a protective oxide film are not established by the cited evidence.
Part of the falsification rule treats failure of untreated SLM specimens to achieve HPT-level grain refinement as falsifying the hypothesis, although that result is predicted by the hypothesis.
